review_type: AI-assisted repository review; not independent assurance
notice: Priorities are proposed project triage, not CVSS scores or accepted risks. Human ownership/acceptance is pending.

risks.title: Complete data lifecycle and subject requests
risks.finding: No all-copies erasure endpoint; logs, decisions, observations, findings, model state, queues, exports and backups can retain related data.
risks.next_action: Design a scoped authenticated export/deletion job with dry-run, identity checks, restore safeguards and explicit remote-copy limitations.

risks.title: Independent resolver and management assurance
risks.finding: No independent professional adversarial review; Live validation and behavioural detection remain experimental.
risks.next_action: Review DNSSEC, hostile parsers, policy attribution, authentication and egress; retest fixes and publish scope/limitations.

risks.title: Data at rest and keys
risks.finding: SQLite/WAL are not encrypted as a whole; a database copy plus secrets.key can decrypt field secrets.
risks.next_action: Document encrypted-volume deployment, least privilege, key rotation and recovery; assess external key custody before adding complexity.

risks.title: Retention coverage
risks.finding: Configuration change history has no automatic pruning; external files and copies have independent retention.
risks.next_action: Add measured per-dataset retention, auditable dry-run/pruning, minimum-evidence policy and backup/export expiry.

risks.title: Release supply-chain evidence
risks.finding: Existing CI SBOMs/scans do not alone establish complete release-image/host coverage or reproducible provenance; several tools use latest.
risks.next_action: Pin reviewable tool versions, retain release-specific SBOM/provenance, verify downloads and match KEV against binaries/images as well as source.

risks.title: Human approval and repository enforcement
risks.finding: CODEOWNERS routes reviews but does not enforce them; branch protection and private-reporting settings have not been verified by this review.
risks.next_action: Verify private reporting, protected main, required checks, review rules, recovery access and external review of high-risk changes.

risks.title: Document and evidence drift
risks.finding: Historical default-mode and local-DNSSEC descriptions became inconsistent with current capabilities.
risks.next_action: Check configuration examples and security/privacy claims against tagged code; use release-specific evidence, not rolling claims.

risks.title: Deployment-specific legal and assurance scope
risks.finding: No global legal applicability assessment, scoped ISMS certification or SOC 2 assurance report is established.
risks.next_action: Identify operator/controller/processor, jurisdiction, sector, hosted-service/commercial changes, contracts and incident obligations.
